column1: # Migration manifest — one line per tool (spoke repo).
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#   repo_name   The new GitHub repo to create (published at https://<owner>.github.io/<repo_name>/)
#   source      Which source repo the tool lives in: NV = NewVisual, MP = My-Projects
#   folder      The sub-folder inside the source repo (its git history is preserved into the spoke)
#   group       Display group on the hub page (informational only)
# NOTE: source repos are NEVER modified. Each spoke gets that folder's real
# git history via `git subtree split`. Edit repo_name values here if you want
# different names, then keep migration/hub/index.html links in sync.
